title: attest-it Seals File
description: Schema for the seals file stored at .attest-it/seals.json. Each seal represents a cryptographic attestation that a gate's fingerprint was signed by an authorized team member.

seals.description: Map of gate slugs to their seals

seal.description: A seal represents a cryptographic attestation that a gate's fingerprint was signed by an authorized team member

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the gate's content in format 'sha256:...'

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the seal was created

sealedBy.description: Team member slug who created the seal
